question: What price per kilogram does the review give for ZrO2 coating precursors?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%price%' OR text ILIKE '%cost%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%USD%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%price%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%USD%' OR text ILIKE '%per kilo%' ORDER BY page
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page BETWEEN 8 AND 10 OR text ILIKE '%ZrO%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%ZrO%' OR text ILIKE '%zirc%' OR text ILIKE '%price%' OR text ILIKE '%cost%'

SELECT id, figure_id, statement, printed_text, value, unit FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%price%' OR statement ILIKE '%kg%' OR statement ILIKE '%cost%' OR statement ILIKE '%zr%' OR printed_text ILIKE '%kg%' OR printed_text ILIKE '%$%'
SELECT id, figure_id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%zr%' OR text ILIKE '%price%' OR text ILIKE '%USD%'

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (6,7,15,16) AND (text ILIKE '%precursor%' OR text ILIKE '%Zr%' OR text ILIKE '%Zirconium%' OR text ILIKE '%US$%' OR text ILIKE '%per%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, label, page, caption FROM figures ORDER BY page
SELECT id, page, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%precursor%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%US%'

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%precursor%' OR text ILIKE '%zirconium%' OR text ILIKE '%alkoxide%' OR text ILIKE '%zirconyl%' OR text ILIKE '%ZrO%' AND page>=10 ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT id, kind, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%price%' OR text ILIKE '%per kg%' OR text ILIKE '%/kg%' OR text ILIKE '%kg-1%' OR text ILIKE '%kg−1%' OR text ILIKE '%kg^%' OR text ILIKE '%USD%' OR text ILIKE '%dollar%' OR text ILIKE '%€%' OR text ILIKE '%$/%' OR text ILIKE '%US$%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%kilo%' OR text ILIKE '%price%' OR text ILIKE '%pricing%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%per kg%' OR text ILIKE '%/kg%'

runs.text: The review does not give a price per kilogram for ZrO2 coating precursors. Its only remark on precursor cost is qualitative: it describes the coating precursors as expensive (for example, "Expensive coating precursor, increase cathode material cost" in the challenges column of the surface-coating requirements table).

A search of the prose, tables, figure text and figure images found no monetary figure, no price and no per-kilogram unit anywhere in the document. The terms "price", "kilogram" and "$/kg" do not occur in it.
Cited support for the qualitative cost remark:
